product_one_liner.value: Lob helps businesses and their marketing and operations teams automate, personalize, print, send, and track direct mail through APIs and a nationwide print network.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 440 employees; this is a profile-based estimate, not an audited headcount.

eng_blog.notes: Technical posts describe SDK generation by the developer-experience team and the routing rebuild by the Postmasters engineering team.

public_docs.notes: Public API reference includes authentication, SDKs, mail products, address verification, events, and webhooks.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable official board lists six roles and no qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title. Senior Analytics Engineer does not qualify.

model_provider.notes: No product AI model or provider disclosure found after reviewing the public API documentation, security material, blog, and subprocessor list. The listed Google productivity service does not establish use of a Google AI model.

compliance_certs.notes: Completed annual SOC 2 Type 2 audits are explicitly claimed. HIPAA/HITECH privacy audits and support for HIPAA and GDPR workflows are also described, but not presented as certifications; they are not included as certifications.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest publicly documented round is dated February 25, 2021, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A readable BDR posting dated October 7, 2026 describes the opening and compensation. It is absent from the separately readable six-role board, so the sources disagree on current availability; confirm before applying.

launched_6mo.notes: August 31, 2026: introduced the No-Code Design Suite, including visual editing, dynamic field mapping, and a production-ready template library; within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: November 12, 2025: announced David Pickel as CFO, Raji Bedi as CPO, and Paul Rosen as CRO; within November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Lob’s Senior Systems Architect job description explicitly describes maintaining Salesforce/SFDC and integrating it with its internal systems. This is evidence of internal use, rather than merely offering a customer integration; the archived posting is not used as evidence of a current vacancy.
